outcomes.text: Use key art terms and concepts accurately when discussing paintings.
Explain how artists use subject and genre conventions (history, portrait, landscape, still life, everyday life, abstract) to achieve intentions.
Explain how materials, techniques and processes in painting affect meaning and visual effect.
Analyse how artists handle composition, colour, pictorial space, light and tone, form, line, scale, texture and pattern for purpose.
Use key art terms and concepts accurately when discussing sculpture.
Explain how sculptors use the human or other figures, or abstract work, to achieve intentions.
Explain how materials and processes, including relief and free-standing work, shape meaning and effect.
Analyse how sculptors handle composition, colour, 3D space, light, volume, mass, line, scale and texture for purpose.
Use key architectural terms and concepts accurately.
Explain how architects use religious, secular, domestic, public, private, civic or corporate function to achieve intentions.
Explain how materials, techniques and processes in buildings affect meaning and effect.
Analyse how architects handle composition, structure, volume, site, scale, architectural elements and texture for purpose.
